tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Hessian in Christoffel-symbol coordinates]

Source: petersen:page-0086, petersen:page-0087 ↗ def:pet-ch2-hessian-lie-derivative ↗ def:pet-ch2-christoffel-symbols-second-kind ↗ prop:pet-ch2-hessian-covariant-derivative

$\operatorname {Hess}f(\partial _i,\partial _j)=\partial _i\partial _jf-\Gamma ^k_{ij}\partial _kf$, the $\partial _i$ being the coordinate frame.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch2-hessian-coordinate-formula \sketch By subsection 2.2,

\[ \operatorname {Hess}f(X,Y) =D_XD_Yf-D_{ abla _XY}f. \]

Substituting $X=\partial _i$, $Y=\partial _j$, and the second-kind definition section 4, $ abla _{\partial _i}\partial _j=\Gamma ^k_{ij}\partial _k$ gives the claimed coordinate expression. Substitution from section 4 rewrites the correction in terms of the first derivatives of the metric.

□
